commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text:
Those pure of mind are blessed with good children, because an effect doesn’t differ from its cause. For those whose company is pure, no undertaking fails to turn out well, because they think it through with good people before they act.

எச்சம் is what remains after you. He takes it as children.
